R-19.name: Creeping Larva
R-19.desc: When any opponent rolls a 1 for their Main Move, they lose that move and the Larva moves 1.

R-14.name: Sticky Slime
R-14.desc: All other runners get -1 to their Main Move.

R-17.name: Turbo Hare
R-17.desc: +2 to Main Move. But if you start your turn alone in the lead, skip your Main Move.

R-11.name: Astral Sage
R-11.desc: Before your Main Move roll, predict a number (1-6). If you roll exactly that, take another full turn right away.

R-30.name: Parasite Hitcher
R-30.desc: When a runner sharing your space starts its Main Move, you may ride along and move the same number of spaces (resolving after them).

R-34.name: Nimble Leaper
R-34.desc: Whenever any other runner's ability triggers, move 1 immediately.

R-01.name: Alchemist
R-01.desc: When you roll a 1 or 2 for your Main Move, you may move 4 instead.

R-36.name: Uninvited Guest
R-36.desc: At the start of your turn, you may Warp to any space holding exactly 2 runners.

R-08.name: Hype Cheerleader
R-08.desc: At the start of your turn, you may make every runner in last place move 2. If you do, you move 1.

R-26.name: Grand Illusionist
R-26.desc: You may reroll your Main Move die up to 2 times per turn (you must keep the final result).

R-37.name: Twin Sparks
R-37.desc: Before the race, you may pick a runner that won an earlier race and have all its abilities this race.

R-23.name: Resilient Hopeful
R-23.desc: At the start of your turn, if you are alone in last place, gain a 1-point chip.

R-28.name: Overdrive Engineer
R-28.desc: You may double your Main Move roll. If you do, you Trip after finishing the whole move.

R-10.name: Blade Challenger
R-10.desc: Whenever you share a space with a runner (even on others' turns) you may call a DUEL: both roll a d6, the higher moves 2 (you win ties).

R-05.name: Half-Beast Lancer
R-05.desc: When you Pass a runner, that runner moves back 2 (never behind Start).

R-33.name: Strict Arbiter
R-33.desc: Every other runner must reach the Finish by EXACT count. If the move would overshoot, they do not move.

R-07.name: Grease Trapper
R-07.desc: Any runner that Passes you Trips as soon as it finishes that move.

R-02.name: Aero Cruiser
R-02.desc: If you start your turn before the 2nd corner, +3 to Main Move. At or past the 2nd corner, -1 instead.

R-22.name: Loyal Vanguard
R-22.desc: When any opponent rolls a 6 for their Main Move, you move 2 BEFORE they move.

R-32.name: Chrono Hijacker
R-32.desc: Whenever someone else rolls a 1 for their Main Move, you take the very next turn.

R-24.name: Abyssal Maw
R-24.desc: When you stop on a space with exactly 1 other runner, that runner is ELIMINATED from the race.

R-18.name: Mind Controller
R-18.desc: At the start of your turn, you may Warp any runner on the track to your space.

R-31.name: Cosmic Lovers
R-31.desc: Whenever anyone stops on a space with exactly 1 other runner (making a pair), you move 2.

R-04.name: Bone Witch
R-04.desc: Trip any runner that stops on your space, or whose space you stop on.

R-03.name: Veteran Mentor
R-03.desc: Every runner sharing your space (including you) gets +1 to Main Move.

R-12.name: Provocateur
R-12.desc: When an opponent ends their turn within 1 space of where they started it, you move 2.

R-15.name: Immense Goliath
R-15.desc: Nobody can share your space (except Start). Anyone who would stop there is placed on the space behind it.

R-20.name: Pacing Strider
R-20.desc: Instead of rolling for your Main Move, you may move exactly 5.

R-27.name: Festival Herald
R-27.desc: At the start of your turn, all other runners are pulled 1 space toward you. Each runner sharing your space gives you +1 to Main Move.

R-29.name: Endless Drifter
R-29.desc: Start the race with 4 point chips. Whenever you roll a 6 for your Main Move, Warp back to Start instead of moving and lose 1 chip.

R-25.name: Springing Toad
R-25.desc: When you move, occupied spaces are jumped over and do not count as steps.

R-06.name: Mimic Phantom
R-06.desc: You always have all abilities of the runner currently in 1st place.

R-16.name: Quantum Shifter
R-16.desc: Instead of rolling for your Main Move, you may Warp to swap places with any runner on the track.

R-13.name: Chaos Orb
R-13.desc: Before the race, reveal 3 random undrafted runners and take all abilities of one of them for this race.

R-21.name: Grand Strategist
R-21.desc: At the start of your first turn, predict a runner to win. If it finishes 1st, the race ends at once and you take 2nd place.

R-09.name: Fortune Dealer
R-09.desc: Everyone may reroll their Main Move die once per turn. Whenever an opponent does, you move 1 BEFORE they move.

E-01.name: Naked Sprinter
E-01.desc: When you Pass one or more runners during your Main Move, gain a 1-point chip.

E-02.name: The Void Null
E-02.desc: Every runner ahead of you gets -1 to Main Move and loses all abilities.

E-03.name: Armored Rider
E-03.desc: Start the race mounted (+2 to Main Move). You lose your mount when anyone Passes you.

E-04.name: Sovereign Tripper
E-04.desc: At the start of your turn, you may Trip the runner currently in the lead.

E-05.name: Slothful Drifter
E-05.desc: -1 to Main Move. When the race ends, if you have not passed the 2nd corner, gain 3 points!

E-06.name: Guardian Patron
E-06.desc: The runner of the player on your left gets +2 to Main Move. If that runner wins the race, you gain 3 points.

E-07.name: Water Blaster
E-07.desc: At the end of your turn, roll a d6 and Trip every runner within that many spaces ahead of you.

E-08.name: Bounding Hopper
E-08.desc: When you end your turn exactly 1 space behind another runner, take another full turn.

E-09.name: Shadow Tail
E-09.desc: At the start of your turn, you may Warp to the space right behind the nearest runner ahead of you.

E-10.name: Prima Vanguard
E-10.desc: If you are in last place at the start of your turn, Warp to swap places with the leader.

E-11.name: Dice Grandmaster
E-11.desc: Roll all 6 dice for your Main Move and choose any number that appears at least twice (six different numbers: no move).

E-12.name: All-in Daredevil
E-12.desc: After your Main Move roll you may keep rolling and add up the results. But roll equal to or lower than the previous roll and you move 0!

E-13.name: Apex Champion
E-13.desc: Your Main Move roll triggers: 1 = move 7; 2 = pull last place to your space; 3 = warp to a runner and trip them; 4 = move 4 and take another turn; 5 = the leader moves back 5; 6 = move 6 and trip everyone you pass.

E-14.name: Bio Cluster
E-14.desc: When you roll a 1 or 2 for your Main Move, draw a new runner card and keep all its abilities for the rest of the race.

E-15.name: Relentless Chaser
E-15.desc: Add the number of runners ahead of you to your Main Move.

E-16.name: Dark Mimic
E-16.desc: The first runner to finish in 1st place is ELIMINATED instead of winning, and you gain its abilities.

E-17.name: Trap Specialist
E-17.desc: Whenever another runner rolls a 3 for their Main Move, they must move backwards instead of forwards.

E-18.name: Fallen Aeronaut
E-18.desc: +3 to Main Move. But if you roll a 6 for your Main Move, you are ELIMINATED from the race.

E-19.name: Static Warden
E-19.desc: Other runners within 1 space of you count every die roll as a 1.

E-20.name: Abyssal Leviathan
E-20.desc: Once per race, at the start of your turn, you may Warp all other runners to your space and Trip them all!

E-21.name: Fun Destroyer
E-21.desc: Every 6 rolled by anyone must be rerolled. Whenever a 6 is rerolled, you move 1.

E-22.name: Burrowing Mole
E-22.desc: If nobody is within 1 space of you, you may skip rolling and move exactly 6.

E-23.name: Gliding Penguin
E-23.desc: Whenever someone Passes you, you Trip. While Tripped you DOUBLE your Main Move roll (instead of skipping) and recover afterwards.

E-24.name: Tantrum Quitter
E-24.desc: If every other runner is 5 or more spaces ahead of you at the start of your turn, the race is CANCELLED and you gain 3 points!

E-25.name: Tycoon Landlord
E-25.desc: Any runner that stops on your space pays you 1 point. If they have none, they Trip.

E-26.name: Aether Soulmate
E-26.desc: Before the race, choose an opponent. When you start your turn within 5 spaces of them, Warp to their space.

E-27.name: Tempest Demon
E-27.desc: Add your total points to your Main Move. But if you lead by 4 or more spaces at the start of your turn, you are ELIMINATED.

E-28.name: Clumsy Hound
E-28.desc: While in last place, triple your Main Move roll. While NOT in last place, you move backwards.

E-29.name: Card Swapper
E-29.desc: When you end your turn within 1 space of an opponent, you may swap control of the two runners!

E-30.name: Golden Heir
E-30.desc: Start the race at the first corner instead of at Start.

E-31.name: Harsh Critic
E-31.desc: Once per turn, you may force a runner ahead of you to reroll its Main Move die.

E-32.name: Vengeful Nemesis
E-32.desc: When an opponent rolls for their Main Move, you roll a d6 too. If it matches, you move that many spaces!

E-33.name: Eternal Competitor
E-33.desc: After its first race this runner is NOT discarded: it joins every remaining race as an extra runner!

E-34.name: Werewolf Fang
E-34.desc: When you roll a 1 or 2 for your Main Move, transform into the Devourer and eliminate every runner you pass!

E-35.name: Cheating Cheetah
E-35.desc: Instead of rolling, secretly set the die to any number. If the player on your right guesses it, you do not move.

E-36.name: Understudy Stand-in
E-36.desc: Before the race, copy all abilities of an opposing runner in this race.

T-01.name: Bio-Hazard Containment Breach
T-01.desc: The Devourer appears at Start and moves a d6 after every turn. Any runner it passes is ELIMINATED!

T-02.name: The Fans Demand Chaos
T-02.desc: Draw the next 2 twist cards and apply both in order.

T-03.name: Finish Line Infestation
T-03.desc: Any runner that stops on the 2 spaces just before the Finish is pushed back 5.

T-04.name: Conveyor Belt Reversed
T-04.desc: The whole race changes direction: Start becomes Finish and Finish becomes Start!

T-05.name: Chaos Wand For All
T-05.desc: After each turn a die is rolled and that many turns are skipped.

T-06.name: Mirror World Confirmed
T-06.desc: All runners warp to the space after Start. Everyone gets +3 to Main Move for the rest of the race.

T-07.name: Scrying Pool Hazard
T-07.desc: Any runner whose Main Move is 6 or more spaces is ELIMINATED.

T-08.name: The Leaking Pinata
T-08.desc: A point chip lands on every empty space after the first corner. Stop on one to collect it.

T-09.name: Cease of Randomness
T-09.desc: Every player rolls once: that number is the result of all their rolls for the rest of the race.

T-10.name: Time Imp Trample
T-10.desc: The runner that triggered this card is removed from this race but joins the next race as an extra runner!

T-11.name: Feast on the Ground
T-11.desc: The runner in last place immediately moves 7.

T-12.name: Season Finale Showdown
T-12.desc: The 1st and 2nd place runners run a short dice duel from corner 2 to decide the cup!

T-13.name: The Swap Meet
T-13.desc: Every player draws a new runner card and may swap it for their runner on the track.

plains.name: Emerald Plains
plains.desc: The classic course: wide corners and few traps.

wildwood.name: Wildwood Rapids
wildwood.desc: Trip spaces and surprise arrows everywhere.

spiral.name: Obsidian Spiral
spiral.desc: A tight spiral full of bottlenecks.

vortex.name: Celestial Vortex
vortex.desc: The grand finale on a rising spiral.
